plan.title: Heart treated vs control DE with QC and pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 heart RNA-seq samples (6 treated, 6 control), unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples after excluding metadata). QC flags a 4x-below-median library size in sample_01 and >60% duplication in most libraries; since there are no UMIs, duplicates are kept (duplication tracks expression, not PCR bias removal) and the low-depth sample is inspected, not silently dropped. Track 1 runs the core DESeq2 differential expression workflow: sample-structure QC -> minimal count filter -> DESeq2 normalization/Wald test with an explicit condition factor (reference = control) -> apeglm shrinkage -> BH-adjusted results at alpha 0.05, cross-checked against an edgeR quasi-likelihood fit for robustness. Track 2 takes the DESeq2 Wald statistic ranking into fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark (staged, human) and Reactome (staged) gene sets. A final report step consolidates DE tables, QC diagnostics, the DESeq2/edgeR overlap, and the enrichment results with full reproducibility metadata.
